store.description: AlicePET OS v0.4 for CardputerZero. A P.E.T. boot screen, then NAVI HOME where you type to Alice (your OpenClaw Navi, reached through a small HTTP bridge over Tailscale) and read her reply in the speech bubble, paging long answers with the arrow keys. [1] NET SCAN checks your hosts (TCP connect, PlayStation rest-mode discovery) and shows n/N ONLINE. [2] opens the CHIP FOLDER; battle combat is not built yet.
